scope: Counterexample to the common-center numerical approximation: existing n/l H-alpha branch centers at the fixed qualified E8 atmosphere and declared baseline observer grid.
criterion_scope: The 0.1 supplied-error limit is the paired approximation budget. The separate selected reference_refinement_sigma remains 0.02; no threshold is reassigned to another numerical control. Distinct-center refinement must name its applicable unchanged declared criterion.

assessment_effect.reason: The common-center approximation exceeds the existing 0.1 supplied-error budget in this paired control. This does not by itself determine accuracy against observational truth or exclude error cancellation.

error_metric: max_i abs(processed_distinct_nl_center_i - processed_common_center_i) / supplied_observational_error_i < 0.1, evaluated at the observed wavelengths after the same declared processing.
interpretation: The three centers already exist in the n/l atom. The paired observer uses them consistently in profiles and absorption/emission coefficients, with the same physical state and processing. This is an observer-only counterexample, not a rate/thermal re-solve.
limitations: The measured failure is at the declared qualified baseline observer grid. Distinct-center quadrature refinement has not been rerun, so this is not a rigorous continuum-limit error bound.
